description:
Use this when the user asks for the contents or a summary of one specific BSE filing of an Indian company, using a news_id from get_stock_events. It may queue processing and use a small daily allowance.

Get the cached PDF-extraction for one BSE corporate filing. Accepts NSE symbol, ISIN,
    or BSE code + a BSE news_id. Obtain the `news_id` from get_stock_events, which lists a
    security's recent filings each carrying its `news_id`.

    Returns cached grounded facts + a factual summary extracted from the filing PDF. On a cache
    miss for any filing that has an attached PDF, calling this tool ENQUEUES on-demand extraction.
    It waits (up to ~30 seconds) only when the queue estimate says the result can be ready in
    that time; otherwise it returns at once with `status="pending", queued=true`,
    `retry_after_seconds` and, when known, an `eta_seconds` estimate from the current queue and
    recent run times — call again after that long to retrieve the facts. Extraction often takes a
    few minutes, so to read several filings of one company use get_filing_extracts (up to 10
    news_ids per call) rather than polling this tool per filing. Extraction works for ANY filing
    with a PDF, not a fixed doc-type list — EXCEPT financial-results
    filings, which return `not_queued` reason `results_available_via_financials` (+ a `see_instead`
    pointer) because their figures come from XBRL via get_financials / get_financial_trends, not
    PDF extraction. Every `pending` response carries a `reason_code` that stays consistent across
    repeat polls of the same news_id: `on_demand_processing` (this tool's own trigger enqueued it,
    or moved an already-queued automatic job up to on-demand priority, and it is still
    queued/running — keep polling), `auto_backfill_processing` (already being processed by
    automatic extraction, not this tool — keep polling), or `awaiting_auto_backfill` (not yet
    queued, but eligible for a future sweep). Other cache-miss statuses: `not_queued` reason
    `no_document_to_extract` (no PDF), `not_queued` reason `on_demand_quota_exceeded`
    (authenticated caller hit its per-day on-demand cap — retry tomorrow, or read
    `attachment_url` directly), or `failed` (retries exhausted; see `error_reason`). Every
    cache-miss response includes `attachment_url` to read the filing PDF directly. Raw disclosed
    facts with verbatim source quotes only — no verdicts, targets, or recommendations.
name: get_filing_extract
title: Filing summary
